question: Which of the following examples correctly demonstrates the proper syntax for an if-else statement in Python?
options: if x == 10: print("Ten") else: print("Not Ten")
if x == 10 then print("Ten") else print("Not Ten")
if x == 10 { print("Ten") } else { print("Not Ten") }
correct_answer: if x == 10: print("Ten") else: print("Not Ten")
